gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i1: Verifies that a {@link NodeIterator} filtered to a single node type can be used to mutate the elements it visits while the traversal is still in progress, witho
ADDED i2: Two sibling divs, each containing two paragraphs, giving a small but nested tree to walk.
ADDED i3: Walks the iterator to completion and asserts that the nodes it yields, encoded by {@link #describeNode}, match {@code expectedTrail}. Also checks the iterator n
ADDED i4: Iterates every node under {@code el} and asserts the resulting trail matches {@code expectedTrail}.
ADDED i5: Appends a short, human-readable description of {@code node} to {@code trail}, followed by ';'. Elements are shown as their tag name (plus "#id" when they carry
ADDED i6: Iterate only Elements, appending "++" to the text of every element that has its own text.
ADDED i7: The element-only traversal visits each element exactly once, in document order.
ADDED i8: A fresh full traversal confirms the in-place text edits stuck on the underlying document.
